description: Given-when-then style testing for Vitest without the overhead. A thin Vitest binding over gwt-runner.
rules: Import the test function from vitest-gwt, not vitest: `import test from 'vitest-gwt'`. vitest-gwt calls Vitest's test runner for you.
Use UNBOUND function declarations (never arrow functions) for given/when/then clauses. The runner binds each clause to a per-test Context, so arrow functions (which cannot be rebound) break it.
Share state between clauses only through `this` (the test Context). No arguments are passed to clauses.
Each clause key must map to a function. Key names are descriptive only and do not affect execution; use ES shorthand for readability.
Expect a thrown error by adding a `then` clause named `expect_error`. It receives the thrown error; otherwise an uncaught throw fails the test.
Chain multi-step flows with a `scenario` array of `{ when, then }` and `{ then_when, then }` blocks instead of a single `when`/`then`.
vitest-gwt major version tracks the Vitest major version: vitest@4.x → vitest-gwt@4.x.
